tools.name: get_public_record
tools.description: Tideline's published end-of-day model states and allocation changes, shown with a 90-day delay (the data of tideline.jbpscapital.com/record). Read-only; published states only, nothing re-computed.

tools.name: get_definitions
tools.description: Fixed definitions of every published field (market regime, allocation states, extension, distance to next signal, signals) and the publication schedule.

tools.name: get_verification
tools.description: Latest public ledger fingerprint with its RFC 3161 and OpenTimestamps receipts, and how to verify the record independently.

tools.name: get_current_state
tools.description: The current published state is delivered to Tideline Core members the evening it is published. Without a Tideline key this returns how Core access works and where the delayed public record is.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_public_record" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Tideline's published end-of-day model states and allocation changes, shown with a 30-day delay (the data of tideline.jbpscapital.com/record). Read-only; published states only, nothing re-computed." → after: "Tideline's published end-of-day model states and allocation changes, shown with a 90-day delay (the data of tideline.jbpscapital.com/record). Read-only; published states only, nothing re-computed."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
